      "review_text": "This place is horrible! The bouncers were incredibly rude and saying disturbing things to me.     {
      "review_stars": 1.0,
      "review_date": "2021-11-15 17:44:26",
      "review_text": "My son was a groomsman at a wedding in Santa Barbara on October 10, 2021, a Sunday night. DO NOT PATRONIZE THIS BAR, their employees are dishonest and thieves."
    },
    {
      "review_stars": 5.0,
      "review_date": "2021-08-11 23:42:10",
      "review_text": "I know, I know.... People might be shocked to see that O'Malley's gets a five star rating from me.   More on that later.  \n\nO'Malley's is hard to categorize which I believe is the reason it is not carrying a higher Yelp rating.   I would describe it as a \"neighborhood bar located at ground zero of tourist central\".  Some would call it a dive bar, it isn't.   I am a bit of a dive bar connoisseur and O'Malley's falls short or more accurately elevates above the standard of dive bar.   Mostly for the lack of bar flys sitting at the counter at 11:00am.  \n\nThey have an amazing team, many who have worked here for years and are loved by SB locals.   Duane and Katie are fabulous and today as I write this Haley is working!   She just made me an amazing margarita.  \n\nNow, why five stars? Because I come here so freakin' much.   How could I ever knock off a star for a place I frequent many times in a month.  SB falls short in the sports bar department and O'Malleys has TV's in abundance!  Inside, on the patio and now out front on State Street.   Whether you love football, Dodger games or European Soccer they have it on.   If you are visiting SB you might have noticed it is not uncommon to pay $16 for a drink, not O'Malley's, I don't know how many times I got my bill and said \"we ordered five drinks\" and heard them respond \"yes, they are all on there\".  As a tourist you might find O'Malley's to be a little unkept for the fancy SB vibe you are used to, but come back on your next visit, and then your next.   I'm sure you will embrace it as I do."
    }
  ]
}

      "review_text": "Katie Teall is an ANGEL!!!  I made a wedding cake for the daughter of a very close High School friend and the Fondant I bought (FondArt) was horrible. The mother of the bride broke in tears, I guess she was worried that I was never going to serve the wedding cake.  These were tears of relief!  We ended up having the most beautiful cake and thanks to Katie.  Katie also build the cake, putting all three tiers together.  Then explained to me how to decorate it.  She told me to get a photo of the container of her fondant because she had tried all the different brands and that was the best of them all.  She said that mine was impossible to work with since it was too dry!  Katie is a walking ANGEL.  I love her, love her and love her.
